question: Find the paper in the collection on quasi-2D bromide perovskite solar cells of the type (PEA)2(MA)n-1PbnBr3n+1 with high open-circuit voltage. Give its DOI and the Voc demonstrated when a hole-transport material is used.
final_answer:
The paper in the collection on quasi-2D bromide perovskite solar cells of the type $(PEA)_2(MA)_{n-1}Pb_nBr_{3n+1}$ with high open-circuit voltage is identified by DOI **10.1002/adfm.201604733** ("High Efficiency and High Open Circuit Voltage in Quasi 2D Perovskite Based Solar Cells"). 

When a hole-transport material (HTM) is used, the demonstrated open-circuit voltage ($V_{oc}$) is reported in the paper as follows:
> "*V*<sub>oc</sub> of 1.3 V without hole transport material (HTM) and *V*<sub>oc</sub> of 1.46 V using HTM have been demonstrated, with corresponding efficiency of 6.3% and 8.5%, among the highest reported."
